subject: Losing your senses
author: ZombieTron
body:
There are worse senses to lose then your hearing. All sense loss normally has degrees and is rarely absolute. I would rather be hard of hearing then partially sighted. Losing my eyesight scares me more then losing my hearing. Although the thought of hearing nothing ever again, especially now I have a baby whose giggle is the most amazing sound in the world to me, is a very frightening thought, it is also very, very, unlikely to happen.

My grandparents all experienced hearing loss in later life, and used hearing aids, and were frustrated that they could not actively participate in conversations in the same way. It is sort of how I feel now, not fully understanding the language spoken is similar to missing words through not hearing them, and it is very frustrating at times.

I once met a guy who lost his colour vision through an accident working on the railway, he was electrocuted and can now only see greyscale. He was quite happy to have a unique view of the world.

I think the wierdest sense to live without, the one which would be hardest to adapt to, would be your sense of touch. I can't really imagine not being able to feel anything. I can't see how your other senses could compensate for that.

subject: Ahhh Sound
author: ichienkai
body:
Nice read that Psyche, thought provoking, interesting, can tell you have spent some time thinking about Silence.... Really can and I know this because I’m losing my hearing. Left ear is almost gone, trying to protect the right from same destructive path. I like looking behind things, not taking anything at face value is the only way to determine what could be truth, what could be untrue. 
I also remember Mr Nero telling me once he races on Revenge in Silence, something I couldn’t do as I love Music, race with it and being trance like but no trance Music thanks lol Had a neighbour way back when who had lost his hearing and sight when he was 7 (40’s when I knew him) his house was beautiful, maintained like he was the Queens butler and he would sit in his garden reading, looking forward with his hands drifting over the bumps and slights on the surface of paper, mesmerizing and I realise now he knew I was watching because his senses where attuned more with his other senses, sense of smell, taste, ALL superior to mine or yours. Not hearing the birds or the Hum (there is a Hum I heard about but only just had the privilege). Man grew flowers you wouldn’t believe, how mad is that?!
The sense of peace in the mans posture, the way he held his body in movement – no I’m not gay – like things reached out to him instead of being found by a blind hand. There has to be peace inside something so silent don’t ya think? I have no children and I never will so you could guess that the sound of a room full of kids holds no appeal to me but to others...? Can see it with Clarity but I prefer a nice Claret and I’m no Vampire either lol
Silence is Golden Psyche they say and hope you never know what that means in the real sense of the word but things happen for a reason and don’t imagine a person who can’t hear wanting sympathy but he/she will expect it for sure, like a person who stutters doesnt want their sentences finished by the person they are talking with. 
Music and the world I see would be the most terrifying thing to lose, the rise and tilt of anothers voice, the rain falling on the Trees and the Grass, the crackle of Fire, the screech of fingers on a Guitar string just before it lands it note and sound of your feet touching the floor first thing of a morning signifying new day, Like Akeru!
Then again, the other senses would be in overdrive for the lack of sound, must be so. 
Does make you think Psyche, infinte number of sounds to be heard or yet to be created. Wouldn’t want to be deprived of them either but lets see what this font is gonna be like anyway eh?! lol

 

--Don't Struggle like That or i'll only Love You More--
